name: N3 Technologies Inc. (3D Printing Canada)
summary: Hamilton, Ontario 3D-printer and filament retailer (N3 Technologies Inc., Canadian owned since 2014) that distributes brands such as Bambu Lab and Creality and sells its own-label 'Made in Canada' 3DPC PLA+ and a Budget PLA/PETG line. The extruder behind the own-label filament is not named.

oem_relationships.notes: Retailer listing (ensun.io) names Bambu Lab among distributed brands.

oem_relationships.company: Shenzhen Creality 3D Technology Co., Ltd. (深圳市创想三维科技股份有限公司)
oem_relationships.notes: Retailer listing (ensun.io) names Creality among distributed brands.
Matter3D Performance PETG/PLA sold on 3dprintingcanada.com and via RobotShop as '3D Printing Canada/USA Matter3D'.

product_lines.name: 3DPC PLA+
product_lines.notes: Marketed as Canadian-made, +/-0.02 mm claim. Also sold on sister store 3dprintingusa.com.

product_lines.name: Budget PLA
product_lines.notes: 1 kg; SpoolmanDB records a 149 g spool.

product_lines.name: Budget PETG
product_lines.notes: 1 kg; SpoolmanDB records a 230 g spool.

additional_notes: Legal name from site JSON-LD. Sister storefront 3dprintingusa.com carries the same 3DPC PLA+ collection. Primarily a retailer: whether the 3DPC line is extruded in-house or by a Canadian contract extruder is not stated, and the origin of the Budget line is unknown, so no manufactured-by relationship is encoded. Budget tier inferred from the line name; no price captured. The collection page was rate-limited during research (details from search snippet and raw HTML).

provenance.conflicts: 'Made in Canada' applies to the 3DPC line only and the actual extruder is unnamed; manufacturing country for the Budget line is unknown.
